title: cried so hard on the internet i ended up at the #MaxtonHall season 2 ...
transcript: I love Maxton Hall. I love James and Ruby. I am so unwell. Last one. Maxton Hall or Oxford University? I'm a bit old for Maxton Hall now. I feel like they should get to Oxford at some point.
classificationReason: Reaction to Maxton Hall season 2 (Prime Video TV series) — not a live stage production.
